text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this season has come around again 
this year! Now, with everyone's help here 
at the training camp, let's make the 
ultimate ramen!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Right, let us go declare war on the 
nearby beach shack. 'Our ramen will drive 
you out of business. Prepare yourselves.'"

In any case, she seemed to have plenty of 
fighting spirit. And so, the intense 
summer training camp began—
